description:
Preview or run Beacon Free cleanup for local AI clutter: stale worktrees, big logs, cache folders, and other whitelisted files that can slow down agents or inflate context. Preview is read-only; apply moves files into ~/.skillfm/cleanup-archive instead of permanent deletion.

USE THIS TOOL WHEN USERS:
- Say the agent feels slow, bloated, laggy, or has too many tools / too much context
- Ask to clean logs, worktrees, cache, temp files, or "清理上下文"
- See a checkup finding about files / cleanup and want to inspect what can be cleaned
- Want a safe audit before deleting anything

DO NOT USE for:
- Overall health score → use skillfm_checkup first
- Token usage / spend questions → use skillfm_show_my_usage
- Unapproved destructive cleanup. Always preview first and wait for user confirmation before apply

TRIGGER PATTERNS:
- "AI 变慢了" / "agent 有点卡" → skillfm_cleanup_audit {action: 'preview'}
- "工具太多 / 上下文太肥 / 清理一下" → skillfm_cleanup_audit {action: 'preview'}
- "确认清理" after preview → skillfm_cleanup_audit {action: 'apply'}

<examples>
Scenario: User says "最近 agent 有点慢, 看看是不是文件太多"
Agent voice (good): "我先跑只读清理审计, 不会删东西" → call skillfm_cleanup_audit {action: 'preview'}
Agent voice (BAD): 直接 rm -rf logs/cache 或调用 apply (突袭式清理)

Scenario: Preview showed 400 MB cleanable and user says "好, 清理"
Agent voice (good): "收到, 我把白名单文件移到可恢复归档目录" → call skillfm_cleanup_audit {action: 'apply'}
</examples>

<hints>
- **IMPORTANT**: Show the `rendered` field directly. It already explains that preview is read-only and apply is recoverable archive.
- The apply action is intentionally conservative: move to ~/.skillfm/cleanup-archive, not permanent delete.
- If preview finds nothing, say no cleanup is needed; don't invent savings or recommend upgrade.
</hints>

action.description: preview 只读审计; apply 将白名单文件移动到 ~/.skillfm/cleanup-archive, 不直接永久删除.

name: skillfm_cleanup_audit
